params.caption: 🕹️ Xbox Cloud Gaming gets a free ad-supported tier A free, ad-supported version of Xbox Cloud Gaming is rolling out as part of Microsoft’s wider push to bring ads to Xbox. Jonathan Stringfield, GM of Xbox Media Solutions, says ads could help the business, but insists there is “zero world” where ads become an option in all games. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 17:26 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @Xbox 📺 Free with ads — fair deal?
